items.title: The Lagos–Ibadan corridor is open
items.body: Take jobs, run bus routes and drive in a convoy. More cities and roads are on the way.

items.title: The West Africa map is here
items.body: Explore 23 cities and 12 planned routes. Lagos to Ibadan is the only road you can drive so far.

items.title: Watch your fuel
items.body: A truck under 10% fuel is flagged on your dashboard. Fill up before a long haul.

items.title: Drive together in a convoy
items.body: Create or join a convoy from the Multiplayer tab and see your friends on the same road.
